title: Brace for very heavy monsoon rains as IMD Hyderabad issues alert
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: IMD issued a weather alert for Hyderabad, reports suggest.
Heavy rain is expected over the next few hours, officials said.
The incident came to light on Sunday.
